main_body: repeating green grass terrain tile patch
evidence: This is a flat terrain ground patch (grass texture repeating in 16x16 tiles) seen from above, which matches the 'terrain' kind.

style.evidence: The candidate is a 16x16 repeating grass tile with 4 distinct green shades (base green, lighter blade tone, bright tip highlight, and dark green shadow/base). While a single repeating tile shows a regular grid pattern when laid out 4x3, its per-tile pixel density, blade clusters, and tonal variation without black outlines are comparable to the simpler grass tiles in the Beodeul reference.
